method: Official FP32 decoder independently decodes each saved FPGA token sequence as a complete utterance; original sample indices, no gain/delay/polarity fitting. Frozen official CPU reconstruction is the reference. Token and conditional decoder components sum as vectors, not scalar percentages.
comparison_scope: Conditional decoder error includes embedding and decoder arithmetic at the same saved FPGA tokens. Before/after token sequences differ, so these conditional inputs differ between variants.
